summary: Careful, well‑documented preregistered paired study that executed as planned and honestly reports a null/degenerate confirmatory outcome (zero baseline failures). The manuscript is methodologically sound, preregistration fidelity is high, artifacts largely support the claims, and the main reproducibility gap (missing Mininet holdout selection seed) is disclosed. No unsupported scientific claims detected. Minor prose/formatting polish could improve readability and reduce provenance density in the main narrative, but these are optional.
optional_revisions: Condense provenance and long artifact-path/hash lists out of the scientific narrative: keep concise disclosure statements in the Disclosure and refer readers to the archived artifact bundle for full provenance details.

In Methods (briefly) emphasize the operational consequence of the pre-registered shared-initial generation semantics (one initial generation reused for both conditions) so readers immediately understand why no repair opportunities occurred when baseline outputs passed the validator.

If possible, add one short sentence pointing readers to the specific archived contamination artifact (analysis/contamination_summary.csv) and stating the holdout size or explicit evidence that the Mininet disagreement detector was executed; keep the missing Mininet selection-seed disclosure as already present if the seed cannot be recovered.
